description: Each month, long the 6 futures markets with the strongest 12-month return (skipping the last month) and short the 6 weakest, dollar neutral. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: Futures cross-sectional momentum 12-1 · long/short · 26 markets (after Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen 2013)
